description: Must check actual eval metrics in registry before claiming two experiments produce equivalent results; caught mixing up TSR/CAR and wrong experiment attribution
type: feedback
---

Never claim two experiments are equivalent without verifying the actual eval metrics in registry. In this incident, mvp_occ_s0 (v1) CAR=0.832 was incorrectly attributed to full_occ_retrain_s0 (v2), which actually had CAR=0.746 — an 8.6pp gap.

**Why:** The false equivalence claim ("v1≈v2") was propagated to memory.md and Director, leading to incorrect D051 gating logic. Director caught the inconsistency.

**How to apply:** When comparing experiments across code versions or conditions, always pull metrics from registry (not memory or session summaries). Cross-check exp_id → eval exp_id → metrics.CAR specifically. Never rely on training experiment metrics (action_loss) as proxy for eval performance.
